Dashboard_WelcomeText1: Welcome to Marketeer! This plugin allows you to manage and track your market board sales across all your characters and retainers.
Dashboard_WelcomeText2: Use the sidebar menu to navigate between your characters, monitor your financial statistics, analyze your sales history, and track market competition in real-time.
Config_AutomationDelayToggle: Enable randomized delay between automated actions
Config_EnableDebugMode: Enable Debug mode (Verbose logging and developer tools)
Command_Config_Description: Opens the configuration menu. Usage: /marketeer config
About_Description: Marketeer is an all-in-one market board and retainer management tool designed to optimize your trading strategies and maximize your profits.
About_Feature2: Comprehensive sales history and profit tracking.
About_Feature3: Inventory management across characters and retainers.
Welcome_Sec_Guidance_Desc: This smart floating window appears when you interact with a Summoning Bell. It provides step-by-step guidance to adjust prices, cancel unprofitable listings, and switch retainers automatically using its single action button.
Welcome_Sec_Chars_Desc: Browse the complete inventory of all your characters and retainers without having to log in. Easily identify retainers that require a price update.
Welcome_Sec_Sales_Desc: Monitor your active listings. The 'Competition' section highlights where you've been undercut and helps you match prices, while 'Price Alerts' warn you of items listed below their NPC vendor price.
Welcome_Sec_History_Desc: Track your completed sales, analyze top earners and item velocity, and visualize your financial growth through dynamic charts.
Welcome_Sec_Watch_Desc: Set target buy or sell prices for specific items. Marketeer will quietly alert you in the background when opportunities arise.
Welcome_Sec_Crafting_Desc: Predictively calculate the profitability of your crafting sessions. The tool analyzes your current component stocks and shows net profit by simulating the entire recipe tree.
Welcome_Sec_Config_Desc: Customize your trading strategy: define undercutting rules (absolute Gil or relative %), configure your whitelist to avoid undercutting friends, adjust loss-prevention behavior, and enable humanized delays for automation.
